target: Violate HACKDAC_p48: when rst_ni==1 and rst_9==0, jtag_unlock must be 0. Find a state where rst_ni==1, rst_9==0, but jtag_unlock==1.

milestones.description: Reset deasserted, rst_9 is 0, jtag_unlock initially 0
Violation: rst_ni==1 and rst_9==0 but jtag_unlock is 1 — JTAG unlock persists through soft reset, disabling register locks
